title: Missing Afghan AN-24 Search and Rescue
description: B-roll of the search and rescue mission for the Afghan-based Pamir Airlines commercial flight 122 which crashed in a mountain pass somewhere between Kunduz and Kabul in Afghanistan. Includes soundbite from Lt. Col. "Jeep" Willi, force flight lead, Combined Air Power Transition. Produced by Tech. Sgt. Mike Tateishi. Also see "Missing Afghan AN-24 Search and Rescue" in the Packages section.

transcript.text: We had a lot of mountainous terrain to search in and a lot of snow covered areas and a lot
of mountainous areas, a lot of challenging area that we had to cover today.
It's a lot easier to find a moving target, but if something isn't moving, then it's very
difficult to find, especially amongst very terrain like we had today.
Because one spot looks like another spot and you would think that finding an aircraft would
be easy, but at the altitudes that we're flying at and the terrain that we're flying in, it's
very challenging to find an aircraft in that terrain.
